name: Rick Hegdahl, VoteVets.org
subject: Can you join us Wednesday?
body:
[1]VoteVets

We’re in a dangerous time, team.

Ukraine needs our help. They deserve our help. Not only to take the fight to Putin and defend themselves, but ultimately to defend all of us.

Much is uncertain these days, but this is clear: Putin has no intention of stopping with Ukraine. He has his eyes on Poland, the Baltic states, even Moldova. If we don’t help Ukraine, their defeat will pull the U.S. into war when we’re called upon to defend our NATO allies.

A strong NATO promotes peace. Victory in Ukraine promotes peace.

Chaos from Trump, encouraging Putin to invade our NATO allies — that encourages war.

Abandoning Ukraine and opening the door to further aggression from Russia — that encourages war.

That’s why this is so important to us. Not to advance conflict, but to preserve peace. And that’s why we’re bringing a ton of our friends to the Capitol later this week to press Speaker Johnson to pass aid for Ukraine. This will be a full court press from VoteVets, and we intend to get this bill across the finish line.

It’s not too late to help us get more VoteVets members and Veterans to DC.

If you want to help, you can make a contribution here and we’ll use it to support our mission in Washington. Any amount makes a difference.

https://act.votevets.org/go/13691?t=1001&akid=24968%2E3013755%2E0Xh6qH

Thank you,

The team at VoteVets

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.votevets.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=24968%2E3013755%2E0Xh6qH

Team,

Over this past weekend I was honored to attend the **DCCC’s Frontline Democrats Fundraiser** with Congresswoman Marcy Kaptur, Congresswoman Joyce Beatty, Congresswoman Emilia Sykes, and Congressman Greg Landsman.

It was an exclusive and private gathering for some of the most influential names in Ohio Democratic politics and we were able to discuss our campaign to some of Ohio’s most influential Democratic circles to help us broaden our base of support.

I had the opportunity to meet one on one with Representative Sykes, Landsman, Beatty, and Kaptur. We discussed strategy, pressing issues in DC that will play a role in our races, and ways that our campaigns can provide mutual assistance to one another. body:
|
#
Peter, This Women’s History Month, we are honored to walk in the trails blazed by amazing women like Mazie. As the first Asian American woman elected to the Senate, and the only immigrant serving in the chamber today, Mazie knows what it means to be underestimated and counted out. That has never slowed down her drive to be a strong voice against injustice and a fighter for a bold, progressive agenda in Washington. But in a tough re-election year, it does present a challenge: On average, male candidates raise about one-third more than women running for the same seats. **For AANHPI women and women of color, that gap is even wider.** And because our broken campaign finance system has allowed billionaire-funded Super PACs and dark money groups to turn our elections into bidding wars, the candidate who spends the most money wins in over 80% of all Senate races. **So we mean it when we say that every donation we receive — no matter the amount — makes a _huge_ impact toward our work to keep Mazie in the Senate** [**Peter, please add a donation of any amount today. clean_body: | Peter, This Women’s History Month, we are honored to walk in the trails blazed by amazing women like Mazie. As the first Asian American woman elected to the Senate, and the only immigrant serving in the chamber today, Mazie knows what it means to be underestimated and counted out. That has never slowed down her drive to be a strong voice against injustice and a fighter for a bold, progressive agenda in Washington. But in a tough re-election year, it does present a challenge: On average, male candidates raise about one-third more than women running for the same seats. For AANHPI women and women of color, that gap is even wider. And because our broken campaign finance system has allowed billionaire-funded Super PACs and dark money groups to turn our elections into bidding wars, the candidate who spends the most money wins in over 80% of all Senate races. Peter,

I'm writing to address a critical issue that recently unfolded in Congress concerning the State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction cap, where bipartisan action was notably absent.

Despite previous criticisms of the 2017 tax law's limitations on SALT deductions, a proposal to amend these restrictions was unanimously opposed by Democratic lawmakers, revealing a disheartening level of partisanship.

Help me fight by chipping in today. [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=Join+Us+In+This+Effort]

This bill proposed allowing married couples to deduct up to $20,000, which would have provided significant relief to families across our state.

name: American Briefing
subject: Referendum
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgtobej9k0p7br4vsh9kbhui1i199e2ofgj75ucg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9j6eor7clh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2kg8f30lmes9sqcr13aga5e2e1q4m2dhr1ibgl0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9j6eor7clh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvuug6clhcc3pcemkrr2c9jf92ed8luek3tj62f8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9j6eor7clh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| American Briefing

subject: Educating our children honestly
body:
American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9bvk2r81v1q6nfssujc1r41tbvoogqe8m4tv200_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9j6eor3cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you’ve even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation’s history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America’s future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum_** —and I’m writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College—and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts—including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That’s an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you—citizens who agree with Hillsdale’s mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale’s 180-year-old mission—to provide “sound learning” of the kind needed to preserve “the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty.” With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ —and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty—and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty—I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I’ve included a secure link for your convenience here:** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfpolg0qk7mi2bicd7141h0bp02fsjoa8r43lfog_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9j6eor3cdh2bs)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Trump Train News
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrph0u9ggjqcum2su7ditjnt4m4mug7058c9h868_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9gm8oj2clh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zur6lln98m23pihi6rigqiimpea3spbglu8obf7g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9gm8oj2clh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrhc7csjqfjoigbmjcc4qfpeo8nd0sbhqccrrdpg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9gm8oj2clh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”

| "When Maria Montero was growing up in small-town Pennsylvania, she used to sit with her grandfather and watch him shout at Ronald Reagan on the television. Most people in her neighbourhood, Hispanics who had moved out into steel and coal country to find work and cheap housing, were true-blue Democrats.
But as she listened, Reagan and his message of hard work and the American dream struck a chord. Now she is running for Congress as a Republican. And increasingly, it is President Biden who is drawing the ire of Hispanics in a realignment that could win Donald Trump the election.
"Over the last 15 years I've seen my friends who were registered Democrats become Republican, not because they've changed, but because they feel that the Democrat party has changed," said Montero, 47, an American lawyer of Peruvian, Irish, and Italian descent with a sheet of long black hair. "They just feel like the values of the Democratic Party are not focusing on America's best interests, like making sure we have a secure border, making sure we're supporting our law enforcement."
Hispanics are the fastest-growing voter demographic in the United States. They make up nearly 15 per cent of the electorate, registering to vote in record numbers -- a quiet wave breaking across the country, from Texas and Arizona to Pennsylvania, Michigan and Wisconsin. This November, for the first time, they will outnumber black voters, whose support has underpinned every Democratic president since the civil rights reforms of the 1960s.
They are some of the most powerful voters, and a rising number are turning towards Trump. In 2020 Biden won Hispanic voters by 21 percentage points but last month a poll by The New York Times predicted that Trump would win the Latino vote with 46 per cent to Biden's 40 per cent (though this almost exclusively polled English-speakers, leaving out the mainly low-income Spanish-speakers who would tend to vote Democrat).
In a poll conducted by the Latino Public Opinion Forum late last year, 58 per cent of Hispanic voters said the Democratic Party best represented their values, but nearly 20 per cent said they had considered switching parties in the past year. Of those, 38 percent said that the switch was from Democrat to Republican, 23 percent from Democrat to independent, and only 11 per cent from Republican to Democrat and 9 per cent from independent to Democrat.
"It's a clear trend, and it's a clear trend all over," said Eduardo Gamarra, a professor of politics at Florida International University, who directed the poll. "There are more Hispanics who are becoming Republicans, and there are also more Hispanics who are becoming independents."

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to launch the next, crucial
phase for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $500, $1,000,
and even more. For others, a contribution of $50 or $100 has been
as much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $1,000, $500,
$250, $100, or $50, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then give your contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to the National Right to Work
Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $500, $250, $100, or
$50 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7uuPmaM2aSgJ3rMpBOubFw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

## Biden Proposes $7.3 Trillion Budget
President Biden unveiled a [$7.3 trillion 2025 budget ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAUAL8Gd1jwwHEoKK5xl2uvtDA82--CDQIS3_39KltvPdJoNH8e88NRpHP77Q60bU2z843eOCsugYOedRfsigioOrRylAIGoaXudqtWXOVqgg9opBEw4jBiuJvBBwMyjB1ZEKCFkiDMcFOqN-Mi7nLUN6n8HaRhWmCglkr_N9HZdlzj__TG0vt0dNHureXK1C8GE4Ppuq7en4v_QAbTR81gEorBJCWDaaGAZ-UgYODLK2zY-OFKIaw8l7QVrJXeyJv7x3d6YuUXtZ3nlF-RauPeHdnRdvIc3fms_d6O2BUb8kUxUr2NTIvtcBS_49qPq74CAAD__63Aak8)proposal Monday, highlighted by increased spending on Social Security and Medicare, as well as higher taxes for corporations and the wealthy. House Republicans immediately blasted Biden's call for $5 trillion in new taxes and $8 billion in spending for climate change, saying it was [reckless and would further burden ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAYAJ8Gb1j8BcLA0MVbuna0sPlsfy0BBCRu375K5853w-k-bvPNY8S0v_s7uL7l2a8dnzBLygUValZDcBuAADmA44YzcWGKq-FwV208k5s0Uht7MdtiuLWGr0os2nKlB3SCCcUkF8xetJSjNQu7cqM0l-tVcEsUg4A91_EzY-oHbPEnP6GOa74P0R29l0bkGxETEdN5nuOWvxOc7cWJmEqO2HFtRExHfjSgey40gg9QG10wQKK9YoyYE10eYYdOS80lNx9phfUrQmu0FUgB0z5UF8r5sps2RLH97jH-hfR_t_wGAAD__-_VZTI)"hard-working Americans." White House officials [called the budget realistic](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8zAMAJ_G3hyQFCXFg4ZvyZZv7Wjoh0pYKHbgqAn69kU6dzzccMB9nJdz1Kbr5X-8Seh1W2Lu-pTFTEgT8cJjCVWExIwS0COQBUYer8FnQVshkqTs2Vjn2WOS4iUna6obNRAQg0GC2TpjDrNPcETPDk0-Es4DgxTt23743HTtV6nte3vKfsjbbWzh2vv9MZh_A50GOsX7Kq_HW71h75qbDHRKWmSd0le5SJ-KVM3apzlm5-I8i2csMTnrMlpEx3AEB9GOeyj3l7amD-cHhsstavut9j8f_AQAAP__asFaUQ) and pointed to included proposals like a $2,000 cap on drug costs and $35 insulin as proof that Biden "values the American people." Republicans disagreed. "Biden's budget doesn't just miss the mark - it is a roadmap to accelerate America's decline," House leaders said.
## Poll: Parents Squeezing to Support Grown Kids
Nearly half of American parents have a child older than 18 that they're supporting financially, including adult children into their 40s and 50s, according to [a detailed new survey](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FyhCAQgOGnwQ4HFjyPgiKN3aVN6aAsuhkOHOB07u0zSZ36L_75vh7zw1GktH26J9oW8uzWRifOikvgoGfdeRsQAVWHVo5SwCC01N1ugzGjNzosuCxixWAWNwaUetDyLo0aOrIgQAslQZjhplRvxkXc5ahvUq13kIZpgZ5aLv13ptR2DPGdTyz9mp9dtHtrR2Xqg8HEYLquq6_upLTV385golRp21tlMAVKLq3kIq-v48il8ZALd_4VG193ir5g4rW9_Lsr1h8XxUj1NjIttqej-Dds__J_AgAA___rGV1k) by Savings.com. The survey shows that parents are, on average, [paying $1,384 a month ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd1iwEP8UFF_jLl97pUXwEjitwQISy29_ytVXjzQazdd9vdtIMT3_2x1N83m1rsU3ropL4KBX3W3GIwKqDo0cpYCb0FJ3wcAkrBtnDzcFqGAWw2gHrSdlRyUmnLtoQIAWSoKYb4NS_Tw-xCRHPUjlJpAz0wK32HLpv3NMLaCnK7-x9C7vHZnQ2lGZ-sdgYbCc59m79HAfyGD5qBksQjFYpGSwJLSFLh4seZ49P2zB1Cr3MdnkoiW6eH0dRy6N2-1FjbsQaSuYeG2v7eI15LP2oe3UFbMdZySKdRiZFs_dRvptan8e-gkAAP__7qVmYw)to help support their kids -- more than twice what they report contributing to their own retirement. For adult children over the age of 28, the average monthly amount drops to $900-$1,000 a month. Nearly 60% of adults say they've sacrificed their own financial security, up from 37% a year ago, Savings.com reports, while 61% of adult children living at home don't contribute to household expenses at all.
## List: The Oldest Bar in Every U.S. State
Today is Travel Tuesday at the Flyover, and if you're in the mood for a historic armchair pub crawl, here's [a list of the oldest bars in every state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngS3WcRADA0MXb-na0cJw2FfhYNkoVd--aufuv37p-3jMj8iVn-t73Cn00uaYOr9o1jeFNzSzkTkUIiQtKSirAO9glJFboOIceW2zM5AXIBf9GEeIFouzLlnJAQENaIXg76PWg7cLOGXNqHRyqLwwQJl7O4fPxs--Uanf7UXnkNoua9h6Py6h3wROAqeltnVIG8WDr_23EDi1munqtyWeAid5hnx8ca18jVYYWPfI9W_V_4X9BAAA__9Q602Y) in America. The list ranges from the nation's oldest bar, the 1673 White Horse Tavern in Rhode Island, through New Orleans' 1722 Lafitte's Blacksmith Shop Bar and into the relatively modern 1847 Village Tavern in Long Grove, Illinois. Many of these long-standing establishments are also high-end restaurants now. You can see which is the oldest bar in your state at the link above, along with photos.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4563011d50414d6eb28d3a39d65ae9b5&_e=abW9CUApuKY9gGNEUQsYQiPmBD9SNpxHvuofEkKROGMr7rJEYLC5ag6PoqbxzSS4D70ZP2ud_5bEUKNS8XsVRi8tQgiUnDn8NnVvsXmu2jLkc2dAxJFLdD8u3CpjFBA64KIC90_XoWPi_r9XPuEaVUrh4nQKQuVGCt1rbFOq2GQ1fg_HUibB7pOijuOe7_F2_4LAA7UNuQjy-Ok_VzvPxqrhGBrJOArDNgNv6Ahnf7PkcGt54TqI-v7ykiU3tfpclzx9qGvseWF8bvxkKyM1d4TEYPvnKoyLZ1aQXdIYmCJS7rIn6eNu2eWB_5e7UisFVb_6bM_mD4Y5oaAt797BQPC5u06vZe-hXTDdKTGGcy6WfZrQaGnRNwSAuLbmpUCLVrXjSNkrG0pkxcj2OgwIj-CKGLLD5eXeKSCEZMKOiJ4%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | | | | Peter, If you haven’t seen the news yet, Kyrsten Sinema isn’t running for re-election in Arizona. Arizona’s Senate campaign is going to be a head-to-head between Ruben Gallego and Kari Lake. And we’ve got some good news, and some bad news. **The good news** is that we’ve built an incredible campaign so far. We’ve got close to 150,000 individual donors, and we’ve raised enough to be really competitive this year. **The bad news** is that this campaign is about to get a lot more complicated — and expensive. We’re expecting millions of dollars in attack ads to start coming our way any day now. More than $230 million was spent in Arizona’s Senate campaign in 2022, and we expect this one to be just as expensive. **What that means is that we need a huge surge of donations from folks who have been on the sidelines so far to stay competitive. We need you to make a donation today.** Our average contribution is about $24. Some give more, many give less. Today, the most important thing is that you make that donation. | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d5ecee895bdb4af398fbd00651cc8d3e&_e=KWErj4BCUUQv1CDgQHY7ywhMhMlIVyovITtJ2W_fZid9yTDNTWVwSoxJQhvwKLUKYtx1C1foMxm4LwZvf43b02TI6Fg69DyNrg5Cegyv01lhU7VlYBS5Aq9QujBI1JJm6Gm25S8hfMU8M4iEiib1VJB_pQPlJcdPlkAepFlQ1rW9uRlEH93lVYXB6aDn0XLGA85tEPa_Px4t8HdFT9oDCJeqpJ4x19W3v-MRcP4YLSK8L9vtQUnwAqdC1EbqQ5IXd6TcWnJd4rXxVDSIQuV3a7yi3oPlLoTjOv2Oop0ymKv9DHaOC1mxrNPaX1jUXhxQLSde9lyHca4qEGKZg1wMwKuH61Eq0KmpmQuG0FFEaVkjpu4hDEqFWhTlqMXtBlpA9_RquZ2Aq62z1JzxxdIu7wKkf2vF-D7RlHHzpjWQt_0%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 30 DAYS TO ACT
UPDATE 3/12/24
APRIL 8 DEADLINE
---
---
| Friends, I've retired from the Virginia Senate officially, but I'm still working hard for you.
After 8 years of serving in the Virginia Senate, I know how things work in Richmond.
The purpose of sending this email to you is to educate and inform you of bills before the General Assembly and the Governor, so that you can hold your elected representatives accountable and stay engaged.
I'm doing this on a volunteer basis and not currently running for any public office.
Any monies donated goes towards offsetting my cost to send emails to you, over 30k supporters. Last month, my Constant Contact bill was $850. If you can chip in to help offset my cost, I would greatly appreciate it.
Please understand my heart, intent and commitment is to you and to freedom.
Please read this email. Freedom is only one election away.
Below is an updated list of actions Governor Youngkin has taken on bills that are currently on his desk. Please see the list below of bills vetoed, signed into law or recommendations made by the Governor.
Democrats included a $2.6 billion tax hike in the budget. Thankfully, Governor Youngkin has already signaled that he will not support this burden on Virginians.
I applaud Governor Youngkin for vetoing a bill that would have restored our participation in Soros funded ERIC Electronic Registration Information Center. This program was giving Democrats an unfair advantage, not afforded to Republicans.
There are also over 40 gun control bills on the Governor's desk. Please contact Governor Youngkin's office now and encourage the Governor to vote against any bill that targets law abiding citizens. All of these links are listed below.
Govenor Youngkin has already vetoed both control bills on his desk:
HB 46 Firearm; transfers to another person from a prohibited person. SB 47 Firearm; transfers to another person from a prohibited person.
Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed in committee, bills that passed both houses, along with a list of actions on bills taken by the Governor thus far.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.
---

Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly.
I will continue to follow the legislation through reconvene on Wednesday, April 17.

clean_body: The Governor has 30 Days to Act | | | | GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 30 DAYS TO ACT UPDATE 3/12/24 APRIL 8 DEADLINE | Friends, I've retired from the Virginia Senate officially, but I'm still working hard for you. After 8 years of serving in the Virginia Senate, I know how things work in Richmond. Based on the email content provided, here is a summary of the key information:

**Sender:** Senator Amanda Chase (Virginia Senate)
**Topic:** Status of Virginia General Assembly Bills (Session Week 10)
**Date Context:** The email indicates the session is nearing its end, with the General Assembly reconvening on **Wednesday, April 17, 2024**. Governor Youngkin has 30 days to review over 2,000 bills.

### **Key Legislative Updates:**

**1. Local Government Bills (Passed Both Houses):**
*   **Charter Amendments:** Several cities received charter amendments, including **Bristol**, **Colonial Heights**, **Falls Church**, **New Market**, **Portsmouth**, **Smithfield**, and **Virginia Beach**.
*   **Affordable Housing:** Legislation was passed to allow localities to adopt "healthy communities strategies" and establish frameworks for preserving housing.
*   **Zoning & Development:** Bills addressed solar/energy storage projects, accessory dwelling units (ADUs), and the regulation of short-term rentals.
*   **Historic Preservation:** New provisions allow localities to provide tax incentives for historic districts and impose civil penalties for the demolition of historic structures.

**2. Rehabilitation & Social Services Bills (Passed Both Houses):**
*   **Cannabis Control:** A major bill (HB 698) established a framework for creating a retail marijuana market in Virginia.
*   **Foster Care:** Legislation focused on kinship foster care and the use of barrier crimes.
*   **Corrections:** Bills addressed the use of canines in correctional facilities, probation period reductions, and the creation of a Corrections Ombudsman office.
*   **Alcohol Control:** Several bills addressed mixed beverage licenses and advertising restrictions.

**3. Transportation Bills (Passed Both Houses):**
*   **Towing & Recovery:** New laws prohibit towing without consent and define prohibited acts for towing operators.
*   **Vehicle Safety:** Updates regarding vehicle exhaust inspections, warning light units, and special license plates (including the 250th Anniversary of the American Revolution).
*   **Infrastructure:** Legislation regarding unpaved secondary highways and bridge improvements.

**4. Rules Bills (Passed Both Houses):**
*   **Commissions:** Various commissions were established or restructured, including the **Virginia Minority Business Commission**, **End Hunger Commission**, and **Henrietta Lacks Commission**.
*   **Health & Safety:** Bills addressed autism advisory councils, crisis receiving centers, and the use of seclusion.

### **Important Dates:**
*   **March 19:** Election of new GOP leadership in Chesterfield County.
*   **May 4:** Congressional District Conventions.
*   **June 1:** Republican Party of Virginia Convention (Hampton, VA).
*   **June 18:** Republican Primary for U.S. Senate.

### **Call to Action:**
The email concludes with a request for donations to support Senator Chase's work. She asks for contributions of **$25, $50, or $100** to help offset communication costs and ensure continued accountability and transparency for her constituents. A donation link is provided.

**Contact Information:**
*   **Senator:** Amanda Chase
*   **Office:** P.O. Box 5811, Midlothian, VA 23112
*   **Email:** amanda@senatoramandachase.ccsend.com

[](https://qpywyl.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjc2NzA3MyxcImxcIjoxMTU2MDAwOTQ0NDM2MDM3NDYsXCJyXCI6MTE1NjAwMTIyNjI3MjI5NjIyfSIsInMiOiI0MmY3NzhhODQ4NzM0YmIxIn0)Dear , As we approach Equal Pay Day, I am compelled to reflect on the persistent gender disparities that continue to plague our workforce. It's not just about numbers; it's about the livelihoods of countless women who are unfairly sidelined due to systemic inequities. In 2021, amidst the discussions surrounding the "great resignation," I couldn't help but ask: who exactly is resigning? As a mother navigating the tech sector, the answer was clear to me: it's women. The gender gap, as per BLS.gov data, stands at a discouraging 1.7%, perpetuated by the elusive notion of "work/life balance," a euphemism for the glaring absence of adequate childcare support. Before the upheavals of 2020, we were making strides towards narrowing both the pay gap and enhancing women's representation in STEM fields. However, the commendable DEI efforts, both locally and nationally, were dealt a severe blow by the pandemic. Our nation's failure to prioritize support for working families—be it through quality childcare, parental leave policies, or affordable healthcare—has regressed the hard-earned progress. Regrettably, recent legislation in our state has dismantled crucial programs that, while not flawless, were instrumental in bridging the pay chasm. Furthermore, Utah Representative Burgess Owens is spearheading initiatives that threaten to strip away vital diversity and equity policies, essential for achieving genuine pay parity. This Equal Pay Day, I implore you to join me in the fight for a future where our daughters are not shackled by discriminatory wage structures. Your support can pave the way towards a nation where income is not dictated by gender but by merit alone. Please consider contributing to the Katrina Fallick-Wang for Congress campaign. Together, let's empower Congress to be smarter, stronger, and more inclusive than ever before. Thank you for standing with us in this crucial endeavor.

clean_body: | | March 12th is Equal Pay Day | | | | | | | Contribute today to help fight for Equal Pay | | | | | , As we approach Equal Pay Day, I am compelled to reflect on the persistent gender disparities that continue to plague our workforce. It's not just about numbers; it's about the livelihoods of countless women who are unfairly sidelined due to systemic inequities. In 2021, amidst the discussions surrounding the "great resignation," I couldn't help but ask: who exactly is resigning? As a mother navigating the tech sector, the answer was clear to me: it's women. The gender gap, as per BLS.gov data, stands at a discouraging 1.7%, perpetuated by the elusive notion of "work/life balance," a euphemism for the glaring absence of adequate childcare support. Before the upheavals of 2020, we were making strides towards narrowing both the pay gap and enhancing women's representation in STEM fields. However, the commendable DEI efforts, both locally and nationally, were dealt a severe blow by the pandemic. Our nation's failure to prioritize support for working families—be it through quality childcare, parental leave policies, or affordable healthcare—has regressed the hard-earned progress. Regrettably, recent legislation in our state has dismantled crucial programs that, while not flawless, were instrumental in bridging the pay chasm. Furthermore, Utah Representative Burgess Owens is spearheading initiatives that threaten to strip away vital diversity and equity policies, essential for achieving genuine pay parity. This Equal Pay Day, I implore you to join me in the fight for a future where our daughters are not shackled by discriminatory wage structures. Your support can pave the way towards a nation where income is not dictated by gender but by merit alone. Please consider contributing to the Katrina Fallick-Wang for Congress campaign. Together, let's empower Congress to be smarter, stronger, and more inclusive than ever before. Thank you for standing with us in this crucial endeavor. | | | | Best Wishes, Warmest Regards, Katrina Fallick-Wang tel:\(801\ 997-0863)‬ ---|---|--- | | Let's not forget the disproportionate impact of the pay gap on women of color. body:
After Kyrsten Sinema announced she was not running for re-election, we knew we had to act fast.
#

Peter -
We had to make a difficult decision this week, and I need to tell you about it -- both because you deserve to know, and because Ruben needs your help.
After Kyrsten Sinema announced she was not running for re-election, we knew we had to act fast.
We were expecting a decision, we were prepared for both outcomes -- but when we saw the Republican response and the money Republican Senators were raising for Kari Lake we knew we had to step things up.
So today our campaign is launching our first television ad of the cycle -- and the hope is that we can afford to stay up.
We hadn't ever really thought we would go up on the air this early, but being the only ones up gives us a huge advantage.
And the bet I made was that supporters like you -- people who know the stakes of this race -- would step up to help close the budget gap.

🇺🇸 The people of Nebraska are RISING!

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/520d9b738aa1/n41kepo7ku-12685592?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=a605acf1ef-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-a605acf1ef-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
As I indicated last week, County Convention Season is just getting started. I was able to speak at the Seward County Convention on Sunday, March 3rd and drove out to Ogallala on Tuesday, March 5th to be the Keynote Speaker of the Keith County Convention. Awesome job by Danna out of Seward and Chris out of Keith County this last week. In addition, a dozen other counties so far have had successful Conventions and I am so thankful for all the Chairs and volunteers that have made these successful. All this last week, County Clerks and Election Commissioners have been returning the list of county delegate signups to the HQ and the sheer NUMBER of county delegates is unprecedented. I would estimate that we are well over 3000 County Delegates and might hit 4000 once I see all the lists.
4000 Republicans that said, "Enough is enough with the direction of America!"
4000 Republicans that said, "I'm ready to be all in on 2024 and bring my time, talents and treasures to the table to further our principles in Nebraska!"
Imagine what great work can be done to support the objectives of the party with 4000 local volunteers! This will be the topic of upcoming Coffee newsletters, because we have the programs and resources to get 4000 volunteers and MORE into a structure/system where they will be appreciated, valued, and heard.
We all watched a State of the Union address on Thursday where President Biden split time between a divisive campaign speech and barely coherent statements on affairs of the country that can only be called outright lies.
Last week also saw a change in leadership at the RNC. Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel stepped down after 7 years at the head of the RNC and the vacancy was filled by a unanimous vote for Michael Whatley. Michael was the Legal Counsel for the RNC leading up to this election and also the State Chairman for North Carolina. RNC rules indicate that the Co-Chair must be of opposite sex, and Lara Trump was nominated and unanimously elected as Co-Chair of the RNC.
I wanted to leave the following information in this email just like last email for us to understand the numbers of where and how we can win elections. We have so much opportunity in 2024 and I can't wait to share more of the growth and stability that is occurring at the local level GOP's. If we focus on connecting to the voters, using Nebraska Values and a handshake, I'm confident that we will have a success 2024 campaign season.
Look at our Legislative District voter registration makeup and Congressional District makeup. We OUTNUMBER the Democrats in 38 out of 49 Legislative Districts! 5 of the 49 Districts are within a few votes of being in our favor! IF we commit ourselves to growing the Republican Voter base in 2024, we will have a super majority in our Unicameral. This effort should translate outward to all local races such as school boards and County races AND translate upwards to races for Board of Education and Federal. Also, since the ODD numbered Legislative Districts (1, 3, 5, etc.) are always up for election or reelection in a Presidential year, we should take EXTREME advantage of 2024's voter turnout. Every presidential year by in large more voters turnout, so we should always be gaining or retaining elected seats in those years.

So much opportunity in 2024. So much to do!
In addition to the County Conventions, each County will be sending representatives (State Delegates) to the State Convention on May 18th, 2024 in Lincoln. We have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. One of the things that deeply concerns me is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

1. Reimagining Election Finance: A National Challenge

---
| | The cost of elections has become a national problem, and we must find a better way to manage the democratic process of elevating individuals to the role of public servants. According to [NBC News](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=eteFRz5RiK_4a5TghAO3Warylti4tVvow2_8RlLvqTI.), the cost of elections is estimated to be four times higher in 2024 than in 2016. With each battleground and high-profile election, costs are reaching unprecedented levels, often unjustified.
---
| |
---
| | Election cycle politics primarily focuses on fundraising and winning the election. However, I believe both of these goals are flawed. Firstly, fundraising is not merely about appropriately funding a race; it has become an industry where profitability is the primary goal. This has led to an uncomfortable arrangement between politicians, constituents, and consultants. Politicians are pressured to raise sufficient funds to avoid losing, constituents are persuaded to donate to ensure their candidate's success, and consultants operate within this system.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=h4nYGc8oHZSlU-WXNIFoyab4ywxAHy0TsyEojPj85Ug.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6ImExZWVmMDRkLTU0OGYtNDMzMi1iYmYxLWZiNTlkNTgxYTYyNSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | In 2022, the top four Senate races collectively spent close to $600 million, arguably far beyond what was needed. This is a staggering amount of money raised by each candidate, with Democrats raising what many consider an excessive amount, far surpassing their Republican counterparts ([USAFacts](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=Z7MjVLdtcKG6UldFLjzfTZ3ivSo6d2BZ4BfEWE9neN4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjBiOTc5ZWRmLTE4ZWUtNDdjNC1iMTdlLTY5MGZhYzc4MTZmMCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). The proportionality no longer makes sense and this leads to my second contention on whether winning an election is the correct goal? A presidential election is undoubtedly crucial, but for the House and Senate, retaining control of their respective chambers is paramount. According to [FEC-reported finances](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=2xFdVD1syjuYW2NyxEn9uZblS0u9fz9YqLRIQtNnV70.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi91cGRhdGVzL3N0YXRpc3RpY2FsLXN1bW1hcnktb2YtMTgtbW9udGgtY2FtcGFpZ24tYWN0aXZpdHktb2YtdGhlLTIwMjEtMjAyMi1lbGVjdGlvbi1jeWNsZS8iLCJyIjoiMGI5NzllZGYtMThlZS00N2M0LWIxN2UtNjkwZmFjNzgxNmYwIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) for Senate and House races from 2018 to 2022, the average spending for a Senate race was $3 million, while a House seat averaged a mere $665,000. It's perplexing to consider that if the $200 million raised by the top four Democrats over their Republican opponents had been distributed more evenly, rather than solely focused on holding the Senate, we might have achieved a supermajority.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=4YgrGQ09zK_49TmfHEi-2_HELGDyb1XN4GGQKnM32iE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjVkMGM4OWE4LTExZDYtNGVjZC04ZGVmLTIwNWVkZDEwZGExOSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | Where does this money come from? Not surprisingly, it does not primarily come from their home districts. As shown in the chart above, the percentage of funds received from out-of-district sources ranges from 59% for Rubio to 91% for Warnock. It's hard to imagine that there were no other races closer to home for donors that were equally or more deserving of funding. If you live in Central or Eastern Washington, you know that we lack state representation, have no voice in the US House, and our local elections often feature disproportionately far-right candidates. So, before you donate $25 to a candidate on the other side of the country, please consider this article. Unless it's for the President, contrary to popular belief, it's not the most crucial race in the nation. This is the first in a multi-part series and here are some additional links you might be interested in:[https://www.transparencyusa.org/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=0B0U5_884v-ph43TaecIs7i4sj668IQZ-tzb0h1wFfw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudHJhbnNwYXJlbmN5dXNhLm9yZy8iLCJyIjoiYjVhYjkyZDYtNzIzNy00Y2IzLTllYmQtNDk3YmYyM2ViZjVkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)[https://www.opensecrets.org/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=IWN_UkPUnAdQmY2tnP7O7qFoyKEnmLIlHznWWx_5zzc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BlbnNlY3JldHMub3JnLyIsInIiOiJiNWFiOTJkNi03MjM3LTRjYjMtOWViZC00OTdiZjIzZWJmNWQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) [https://www.pdc.wa.gov/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=_nmsWm_d2Z24e_Fz0pgAQpZgGlfIbtrHrM_ZEFKBB9Q.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGRjLndhLmdvdi8iLCJyIjoiYjVhYjkyZDYtNzIzNy00Y2IzLTllYmQtNDk3YmYyM2ViZjVkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) [https://www.fec.gov/data/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=C-NukFIUEHS4TgEy4-LQ8DPaA5rhC5XbPycsAktfqcM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi9kYXRhLyIsInIiOiJiNWFiOTJkNi03MjM3LTRjYjMtOWViZC00OTdiZjIzZWJmNWQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)

| | 3\. The Darkside Of Political Excess
---
| | Did she ever have a chance? If you follow any of her social media channels, you will immediately know who [Katie Porter](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=l7wLJkiBhZ21AVGlHWX1IVe144X2h6mEwp2sGowDIsk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9wb3J0ZXIuaG91c2UuZ292LyIsInIiOiI2YjBhNTcyMC1hZjg5LTQwOTctYjUyYy0wYmY3YWY3OTVlOTciLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) is. She was the Democratic Representative from California’s 47th district who, with little more than a whiteboard and simple math, made CEOs crumble before her. She was magnificent. So why, when she ran for Dianne Feinstein’s open seat against Adam Schiff (D) CA-30, did she get treated so poorly? In an article by The [Washington Post](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=f_RdV_jTvTZ5z4FVWBk9JhULReOxHt0c0jW1qX2Ogb0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbnBvc3QuY29tL2VsZWN0aW9ucy8yMDI0LzAyLzI5L2FkYW0tc2NoaWZmLWthdGllLXBvcnRlci1zdGV2ZS1nYXJ2ZXktY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1zZW5hdGUtcmFjZS8iLCJyIjoiNmIwYTU3MjAtYWY4OS00MDk3LWI1MmMtMGJmN2FmNzk1ZTk3IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), it was made clear that Schiff and supporters spent $11 million to ensure she did not make it through the primary. Your first thought might be that he spent it on his advertising, but you would be wrong. You might think he ran negative ads against her, and whereas that would be cheap, it would still be within the rules, but you would be wrong. If you guessed that he ran ads to promote the Republican opponent Steve Garvey so that he would get through the jungle primary (top two vote-getters), you would be right. I have seen low in my day, but that is beyond the pale. Katie Porter had more adversaries than just Schiff. An article published by [Slate](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=BxrRs5aaukAl1L3q63ViQi2lDfMaVYonYelXTr3uNW4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zbGF0ZS5jb20vbmV3cy1hbmQtcG9saXRpY3MvMjAyNC8wMy9jYWxpZm9ybmlhLWRlbW9jcmF0cy1wb3J0ZXItc2VuYXRlLXNjaGlmZi1nYXJ2ZXktcmlnZ2VkLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiNmIwYTU3MjAtYWY4OS00MDk3LWI1MmMtMGJmN2FmNzk1ZTk3IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) stated that the [Winklevoss twins](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0dOukZJBk/c?w=dnzOxTc67PfOXYf3lrQtsaerHD5a87GCaIavxfhzcM8.) kicked in another $5 million to make sure she did not make it through the primary. Do the simple math here: Adam Schiff was so intimidated by her capability that he spent a huge sum to promote a Republican opponent to shut her out, and the Winklevoss twins spent $5 million of their own money to make sure she did not get the Senate Seat. To me, that adds up to the best replacement for the bigger-than-life career of Dianne Feinstein not going to the best person, but to the person who was able to raise such an excess of campaign money he had enough to ruin another Democrat. Next time you are writing a donation check, remember that you know your neighbors best and our struggle is equal or more than anyone else.

Reimagining Election Finance: A National Challenge | | The cost of elections has become a national problem, and we must find a better way to manage the democratic process of elevating individuals to the role of public servants. According to , the cost of elections is estimated to be four times higher in 2024 than in 2016. With each battleground and high-profile election, costs are reaching unprecedented levels, often unjustified. | | | | Election cycle politics primarily focuses on fundraising and winning the election. However, I believe both of these goals are flawed. Firstly, fundraising is not merely about appropriately funding a race; it has become an industry where profitability is the primary goal. This has led to an uncomfortable arrangement between politicians, constituents, and consultants. Politicians are pressured to raise sufficient funds to avoid losing, constituents are persuaded to donate to ensure their candidate's success, and consultants operate within this system. | | | | In 2022, the top four Senate races collectively spent close to $600 million, arguably far beyond what was needed. This is a staggering amount of money raised by each candidate, with Democrats raising what many consider an excessive amount, far surpassing their Republican counterparts (). The proportionality no longer makes sense and this leads to my second contention on whether winning an election is the correct goal? A presidential election is undoubtedly crucial, but for the House and Senate, retaining control of their respective chambers is paramount. According to for Senate and House races from 2018 to 2022, the average spending for a Senate race was $3 million, while a House seat averaged a mere $665,000. It's perplexing to consider that if the $200 million raised by the top four Democrats over their Republican opponents had been distributed more evenly, rather than solely focused on holding the Senate, we might have achieved a supermajority. | | | | Where does this money come from? Not surprisingly, it does not primarily come from their home districts. As shown in the chart above, the percentage of funds received from out-of-district sources ranges from 59% for Rubio to 91% for Warnock. It's hard to imagine that there were no other races closer to home for donors that were equally or more deserving of funding. If you live in Central or Eastern Washington, you know that we lack state representation, have no voice in the US House, and our local elections often feature disproportionately far-right candidates. So, before you donate $25 to a candidate on the other side of the country, please consider this article. Unless it's for the President, contrary to popular belief, it's not the most crucial race in the nation. We will be joined by some excellent coaches: Amy Peters and Maria Fernandez along with guests from the Sunnyside and Prosser city councils. | | | | | | | | | 3\. The Darkside Of Political Excess | | Did she ever have a chance? If you follow any of her social media channels, you will immediately know who is. She was the Democratic Representative from California’s 47th district who, with little more than a whiteboard and simple math, made CEOs crumble before her. She was magnificent. So why, when she ran for Dianne Feinstein’s open seat against Adam Schiff (D) CA-30, did she get treated so poorly? In an article by The , it was made clear that Schiff and supporters spent $11 million to ensure she did not make it through the primary. Your first thought might be that he spent it on his advertising, but you would be wrong. You might think he ran negative ads against her, and whereas that would be cheap, it would still be within the rules, but you would be wrong. If you guessed that he ran ads to promote the Republican opponent Steve Garvey so that he would get through the jungle primary (top two vote-getters), you would be right. I have seen low in my day, but that is beyond the pale. Katie Porter had more adversaries than just Schiff. An article published by stated that the kicked in another $5 million to make sure she did not make it through the primary. Do the simple math here: Adam Schiff was so intimidated by her capability that he spent a huge sum to promote a Republican opponent to shut her out, and the Winklevoss twins spent $5 million of their own money to make sure she did not get the Senate Seat. To me, that adds up to the best replacement for the bigger-than-life career of Dianne Feinstein not going to the best person, but to the person who was able to raise such an excess of campaign money he had enough to ruin another Democrat.
