---
| **New Polling Shows Barrett With 7 Point Lead**
---
[New polling](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65f09856645f0315d3982b4c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.msn.com%2Fen-us%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2Frace-to-replace-slotkin-in-michigan-favors-republican-tom-barrett-gop-polling-memo%2Far-BB1jI3PH&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65f058c1deec415268ba3191&l=en-US&s=J4Soe6tiYe5_2FwwaE73T30cd5k%3D) in the top open congressional seat race in the country, Michigan’s 7th District, shows Republican Tom Barrett leading Democrat Curtis Hertel 44-37%, giving Barrett an early lead in the battleground seat vacated by Democrat Elissa Slotkin, who is running for Senate.
---
[_ _ Flip MI-7 _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65f09856645f0315d3982b4c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fbarrett-leads-polls&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65f058c1deec415268ba3191&l=en-US&s=ezuVP7WLOHe3RC9V_xf8B1Dq9-Y%3D)
---
The poll of 415 general election voters was conducted Feb. 20-21 and has a margin of error of +/-4.77. The poll showed illegal immigration as the top issue of concern for district voters, a view held by 21% of those surveyed. After voters are presented with positive and negative messages on both candidates, Barrett’s lead increases to 12%. The poll showed former President Donald Trump leading Joe Biden by 5% in the district, and shows Barrett running 5% ahead of the generic ballot, which favors Republicans by 2%.Read the memo [here](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65f09856645f0315d3982b4c&u=https%3A%2F%2F24.03.04.PollingResults.pdf&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65f058c1deec415268ba3191&l=en-US&s=Yt36_bEgXnuLPxaD_9RbHtJCZ5Q%3D).

| _Tom Barrett (left) served 22-years in the U.S. Army, while his opponent, Curtis Hertel, Jr., served 22-years in elected office._
---
[_ _ Support Tom _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65f09856645f0315d3982b4c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fbarrett-leads-polls&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65f058c1deec415268ba3191&l=en-US&s=ezuVP7WLOHe3RC9V_xf8B1Dq9-Y%3D)

Michigan’s 7th District is the top open seat in the country and is considered one of the [9 seats that will decide the congressional majority](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65f09856645f0315d3982b4c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fthehill.com%2Fhomenews%2Fcampaign%2F4519790-battle-for-the-house-9-races-that-will-determine-the-majority%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65f058c1deec415268ba3191&l=en-US&s=27qsqZYeZyQb9vSK17kpR3d8UK0%3D). Barrett has been endorsed by Speaker of the House Mike Johnson, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, House Majority Whip Tom Emmerg, Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik, and NRCC Chairman Richard Hudson.

Peter, I'm proud to be the endorsed Democratic candidate for Ohio's Seventh Congressional District. Our country is facing real challenges, and we need serious public servants who are committed to delivering bipartisan solutions. That's why I'm in this race: to Make Congress Work Again. Unfortunately, our current Congressman, Max Miller, has failed to represent the best interests of our district. Instead of working towards bipartisan solutions, he's focused on divisive politics and personal attacks. We deserve better. I'm writing to you today to ask for your support in our mission to defeat Max Miller and ensure that Ohio's Seventh District has a representative who will prioritize the needs of our community. I've spent my life fighting for Democratic values and working to make a difference in our district. From grassroots organizing to advocating for critical issues like healthcare and infrastructure, I'm committed to building a brighter future for all Ohioans. But I can't do it alone. I need your help to spread our message, mobilize voters, and win this election. Your contribution will make a real difference in our campaign and bring us one step closer to victory. name: Lucas Kunce
subject: I’m a U.S. Marine veteran who was exposed to toxic burn pits in Iraq
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Josh Hawley turned his back on veterans like me.
#
Peter — I’m a Marine veteran who was exposed to toxic burn pits in Iraq.
**Nearly two years ago, Josh Hawley turned his back on veterans like me by voting to stall the PACT Act** , legislation that expanded healthcare coverage for those of us who were exposed to these toxic pits. Now I’m running to replace him in the U.S. Senate.
So before I ask you to **[add a donation of any amount to my grassroots campaign,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44501?refcode=em20240312-5030&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5030%2E614464%2ELPS7Du) please let me share more about why this issue is personal to me and how it has impacted so many of my fellow veterans.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44501?refcode=em20240312-5030&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5030%2E614464%2ELPS7Du)
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger by blocking efforts to expand healthcare for veterans exposed to these toxic burn pits.

What they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country. That’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.

It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us. Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty. For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. # Three Things to Know This Week:
---
1. **Matt Dolan Earns “Rock Solid” Endorsement from Fmr. Ohio U.S. Senator Rob Portman.**

2. **Ted Diadiun: Matt Dolan is “Best Chance” to Defeat Sherrod Brown.**

3. **Election Day is Just One Week Away! Be Sure to Vote On or Before Tuesday, March 19th.**

# Get up to speed...
---
| | |
---
_**Matt Dolan Earns “Rock Solid” Endorsement from Former Ohio U.S. Senator Rob Portman.**_
* On Friday, Senator Rob and Jane Portman formally announced their endorsement of Republican Matt Dolan’s bid for U.S. Senate in Ohio.

* State and national media outlets, along with pundits and GOP leaders from across Ohio highlighted the significance of Portman’s “game-changing” endorsement:

* **The Associated Press: **[**Republican Matt Dolan has landed former US Sen. Rob Portman’s endorsement in Ohio’s Senate primary**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qwJCp1whvKGeDLELm8ZL_ZbMbAcb_yjA_7gK5HTn2a17KwA_2_uEh9v0vGB-CJlmee6N5OVlW9jgfo5XwJchMgv-0BIXPHbfo7SjeSKUMp0Z4ZPrynr5EqM0dEaeEGj_ixGsijFCW9Aq0mmlCnkblZlZGtSyGAK2JWFaurLcWxbA%3D)._“Republican Matt Dolan has landed the endorsement of former U.S. Sen. Rob Portman in the fractious three-way primary to take on Democratic U.S. Sen. Sherrod Brown this fall, a potentially important boost in the final run-up to the contest. In a letter addressed to fellow Ohioans, the Cincinnati Republican and his wife, Jane, said they decided that Dolan’s ‘conservative record of accomplishment and his commitment to continue to focus on achieving results in the U.S. Senate set him apart from his rivals.”

_
* _**The Cincinnati Enquirer (Gannett Ohio): **[**Former U.S. Sen. Rob Portman backs Matt Dolan in heated GOP Ohio Senate primary**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5q3QwbIjAAAhvOqrgQq9Ucee8rv1c6AXog3lM4uMuOE1qZKVLUIJjFM8TWa1jqekkIXPwAkyDzX20T6EoAtSsbMAmh-9WWpGgO4GjwTul71uU6BFrtPtUUj_d1DJu6DNYWN6bcb9xTfdi5frkf8I6BLaBzsUSQx6-NB9v0ngy6AlU%3D). “Former U.S. Sen. Rob Portman is backing Matt Dolan in Ohio’s Republican U.S. Senate primary, a nod that could boost Dolan’s profile in the final days of the race. In a letter to Ohioans, Portman and his wife, Jane Portman, cast Dolan as a problem-solver who is best equipped to tackle the economy, border security and other issues in Washington.”

_
* **The Dayton Daily News: **[**Republican U.S. Senate candidate Matt Dolan announces Portman endorsement and campaigns in Dayton, Butler County**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5q4KkrHaNok5hm5oBEvNTWDr_1vHGhXtj2UrbkQ-ByRMdFihmUxsFZ1sExeYrVFJ-uPhwKt3Cd2w1gba5ZNmfhBj_SESdHrRbsxrg6FqU_z8BndsPByHdfE1OzhKCHLNdAZyXoZjvsLauiA7QLHWT7gzTLwtYmwXjTzXZVQQjeLUc%3D)._ “Former U.S. Sen. Rob Portman today endorsed state Sen. Matt Dolan, R-Chagrin Falls, in the race for U.S. Senate as Dolan brings his campaign to the Dayton and Butler County region today and Saturday.”_

* _**The Hill: **[**Portman endorses Dolan in Ohio Senate GOP primary**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qT-9A4zb7-dYUuBHnVH0CriteeOGkE4h6IVLBIG7_Tidfxydytki0PdhZ_dDHq9DB1E4jqFiG03tf7-KXiptwxJK_HzejNaLxx5Wb5c_eKwAyzUaOCKsnR_5mV5hk5cDNkb7ze976HmlY83oqt8WwxLOMg8AOHuMMABWVdEvFgTo%3D). “Former Sen. Rob Portman (R-Ohio) and Jane Portman endorsed state Sen. Matt Dolan (R) in the Ohio Senate GOP primary on Friday, saying “after much consideration, we feel that Matt Dolan’s conservative record of accomplishment and his commitment to continue to focus on achieving results in the U.S. Senate set him apart.”

_
* **Political reporters and pundits across the state also weighed in on X:

**
* **[Doug Moormann](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qSN1GiILg_wGJfTt38Q0c4FQekz9m68BikI60JN48tJCKcqWEQH9XBmzaIhLdwX6DmkjE2ixzbTTVdAIKYE6SthVFcjrVg2ZE36kdaZQhDjNYwDXDEZkMTiwK2nfRiyKSGdLNWirCOzNqZtkgIp60orrHqkijWDJVnKC_Bdec3qw%3D), **the mayor of Madeira, called Portman’s announcement a “rock solid endorsement”

* Senior political reporter for Gannett Ohio, [Haley Bemiller](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qatqAyXwg31xm_C15ORTmi2unY4YSDiwlKtRySoA74uRf64BjJr_NdxrEIlPsv4G5M557C8SFa0BwcAl2dr1V5y4hKFL6mpFU2hPb9C4wCvnRuPVUZe4hSNdqvNs_nnlO9DCS8HxD09giTRNWNkSR30pXsEXKzNkaUZFqIM9OIkI%3D), said Portman’s endorsement provides “southwest cred” for Dolan’s campaign.

* Senior political analyst for 91.7 WVXU [Howard Wilkinson](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5q5EMduuCSlrLO6uClERmS8pkAGAJi-oApkYHkMJXn_LBoIa4Cb9d6u_seL_t_ajRNc5ISnlNa9fnb84tbVhxXh86OUcRd4dbi9BssmHdl54jxImC6PPgDf8f41kzyHaTuF43iGCGBD4niKCDelH1K5Ed8FJSHM6dyx9FwFX6QMtk%3D) called the endorsement “big news”, saying “let’s see how Bernie and Frank spin this one...”

* [Hannah Thomas of WLWT](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qMJikO5ew8zTNhzldqeuL391em254lN4D-D5YUM0c3B6GLsXg_sNoGraRRa2_FaOP4-eDwoMmrpTFTD_onczWbO3ONaMHc4Q6NwmuxNnxclEPmoMoenxIs_GOZIraq7NPMcv6Wm0y881gYfl7oGAqycll6F4fMGtQL3HecuSm-X0%3D) said Portman’s “reputation and popularity in SW Ohio could help boost the Dolan campaign in the last 11 days before the primary.

* Conservative syndicated radio host [Hugh Hewitt](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wT8iEFxk19yXbUFgGj07bgj5F6QhINtBR950IWylaq5qLN-lryYj1eyISVVzMNibgodelOy81sOdAUWt8_TAoF5qYwGZFQhjEVGKBuOes6v8PgwCtgBypF09vHOQYTqJve-1HJ-jzfJaHYashVzdV9fSe68MuLaVv-95Til49BtkEXQUlXjzEaXdFnWJeV5pTj6Pbro_s89Ey8Lk8jFG1dk%3D) called it an “interesting development,” further stating “I expect Dolan to spend heavily featuring the very popular Portman in the closing sprint in this close three-way race.”

_**Ted Diadiun: Matt Dolan is “Best Chance” to Defeat Sherrod Brown.**_
* In case you missed it, Cleveland Plain Dealer editorial board member Ted Diadiun [dedicated his Sunday column](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2b3c901ec95f44088912a708a874529e&_e=7kXPdxITADSTHis8iN10wf3wsbzoV_T-FJ_hMCwlHdBHMNJSRHwHcieUBX2-ILdBk5NDAWq_rz902dL8rkToOZqsXyxGDx09Sg32kpy4ZtuSChU8DSEo4vguE7iZbB9C1BO8hoaftPD8yX0U-tg305d-zvM5s6KbWY1bjxQhKPAxBqhbUM__s8lVI0282c0XpkxFV5O5jxRFtT362IdCEP2qxcOXMi9sINos_z4mThrL6cGsnQFI_Jryaq6woEV9c06EhY4Xs0igCRlfuQPHR_AbRls8kFDumQDIFG8nIEzmj6IXNes8N6N1AYuhRVgf) to articulating the case for Matt Dolan’s U.S. Senate candidacy. Not only did Diadiun note that Dolan is best prepared to serve as Ohio’s next U.S. Senator, he also indicated that nominating Frank LaRose or Bernie Moreno represent would make it harder for Republicans to defeat Sherrod Brown in November.

| | | | | [SIGN NOW: Congress must put an end to Big Money’s grip on our democracy >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tecd34c81-f399-4c5a-9698-ca2611f184e2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, fourteen years ago the 5-4 Citizens United ruling by the Supreme Court opened the floodgates for unrestricted Big Money spending in our elections. And right now, we’re seeing the consequences: Corporations, special interest groups, and some of the wealthiest people in the country are gearing up to spend billions of dollars to influence the 2024 elections. When they get this kind of power over our elections, we all pay the price – with decaying infrastructure, inaction on guns and climate, and tax giveaways to the ultra-rich. But Peter, it doesn’t have to be this way. Congress can overturn the disastrous Citizens United decision and pass simple reforms like the Freedom to Vote Act and the DISCLOSE Act, which would limit Big Money’s influence in our democracy and empower everyday Americans to have a stronger say. [If you believe, like we do, that government should be of, by, and for the people – then please join us in calling on Congress to END the Citizens United era.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tff90b397-0694-4941-b410-cb1f92382de2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| 2024 will likely be the most expensive election in history, with spending expected to top $10.2 billion. [1] That’s because the Citizens United decision has not just allowed, but encouraged, the wealthy and powerful to buy access to politicians and contribute unrestricted sums of money – effectively drowning out the voices of everyday Americans. Peter, this is NOT how our democracy is supposed to work. We the People should call the shots when it comes to the issues that impact our everyday lives, not a shadowy network of wealthy special interests. We must urge Congress to overturn Citizens United vs. FEC and pass the Freedom to Vote Act and the DISCLOSE Act. These common sense changes would help shine a light on secret political spending, improve our campaign finance rules, and establish small-dollar citizen funded elections – giving ordinary Americans a greater say in our democracy. [Sign the petition to Congress: We need a democracy where all voices can be heard. Overturn Citizens United now!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te043493d-0a1d-4dd4-b785-0ed70082c6f8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Peter, **Bill Spadea here, freshly back from the front lines of our nation's most pressing battlefield—the Texas-Mexican border**. Our primary mission was to witness the severe situation that is unfolding firsthand. My biggest takeaway? What is happening at our border is more than a crisis; **_it's a full-blown invasion._**
---
|
---
Standing on the Texas side, with the Rio Grande at my back, the reality was stark. A few hundred yards away, a cartel-run access road cuts through the landscape, a glaring testament to the dangers we're facing. More chilling, under the harsh glare of the sun, lay a cartel training camp, a hub of human trafficking, drug and gun running—all contributing to the erosion of American sovereignty.
---
| This isn't mere rhetoric; it's the grim reality we encountered. Among the migrants crossing illegally, a staggering 1 in 5 are hardened criminals—rapists, child predators, murderers. **Our country is facing an****invasion not just in numbers but in the threat to our way of life.**
Yet, there's a glimmer of hope amidst this turmoil. Operation Lone Star, led by Governor Greg Abbott, stands as a defiant response to this encroachment, a testament to what's possible when leadership embraces common sense over complacency. Our journey to the border wasn't about spectacle; it was a demonstration of what's at stake if we remain passive spectators. As I've returned, I bring with me not just stories but a call to action for each of us to take a stand. This is where you come in. ---
| | On All Women's Equal Pay Day, I'd be wrong if I didn't share this important fact:

_**In 2024, white women are still making 84 cents for every dollar men do – and the income gap is even worse for women of color at just 65 cents.**_
---
| [ ](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=ba490f1d04&e=4d37f34e0f)
---
| Take it from me, women have always had to work harder than men just to make a name for themselves–all the while making less money for doing the same job! It is past time for our elected officials to elevate women and take steps towards an equal and inclusive environment for all.

John James has done _**nothing**_ to advocate for important issues like the gender wage gap. Combine this with his idea that he’s “100% pro-life,” and his attitude towards women is disappointingly clear.

I'm running because our community needs a voice in Congress willing to fight for a better future for EVERYONE, and John James just isn't it.

[**I'm ready to be the loud and unapologetic advocate for what our people need, but I need your help. Will you support my campaign with a donation today?**](https://milwaukeedems.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e61dc0cbc36b6b9ece6e4cb38&id=be7cf6d315&e=4d37f34e0f)

---
| Thank you,
Emily Busch
---
| | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University.

Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families.

Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods.

She and her husband, a retired firefighter and Marine, enjoy camping, fishing, and visiting national parks in their free time.

The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California.Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I’d go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent.And that’s why I’m running for Senate.**_We Republicans_ pulled our country out of the 1970’s Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.**And I believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values at the heart of everything we do.But there is no way I can pull it off without you.**[**Will you rush a contribution to my campaign of $35 or more today?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoh3pda96ki3be06jkdd08t5nhojbst61pi08sd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c9jmcor2chh2bs)** I’ve lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you –- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I’ve never seen before.They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California...I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a _**Republican win**_.I’m fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I’m not just taking the field for Californians.When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff...**...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs.** Thank you and God Bless,

In fact, it’s a email I never thought I’d be writing to you. | | | As of March 5th, it’s official. I’m going head-to-head with Adam Schiff in November.Democrat policies have brought America to its knees.There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California.Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. March 19th will be here before any of us know it, and to that end, I’m going to ask for your financial help a few times in the body of this email. Whether everything helps. Democrats continue to outpace in fundraising, and I, for one, intend to fight to make sure that we have just enough cash to win this primary outright. I’ll let you know what this email raises when I reach out tomorrow afternoon. I’d love to be able to report that we raised $5,000 off this email alone. Our country can't handle six more years of Ted Cruz, his attacks on reproductive freedoms, his dismantling of our fundamental voting rights, and his endless self-centered antics. He's proven time and time again that his only loyalty is to himself, not the people he's supposed to represent.
It's time to send him packing. Not only because Texans deserve so much better – but because if Colin wins, Democrats are virtually guaranteed to retain control of the Senate, which is our last line of defense against the far right.

That's why I'm personally asking: Will you donate $20 right now to power Colin and Serve America to victory and defeat Ted Cruz? body:
Pasquarella for Congress In Gratitude Thank you for your support and commitment to peace. The past five months of my campaign have been bittersweet...the joy of the inspiring journey coupled with the on | | | | **Pasquarella for Congress** |
---|---
|
## In Gratitude
---
---
Thank you for your support and commitment to peace. The past five months of my campaign have been bittersweet...the joy of the inspiring journey coupled with the ongoing despair of witnessing the genocide of the Palestinian people. My campaign started as a quest to understand our political system from the inside, as a how-to experiment on getting one’s name on the ballot and running for Congress, but then transformed into a campaign to denounce Congressman Salud Carbajal and our government’s complicity in the Palestinian genocide.
As of Tuesday March 12h, with 67% of the votes counted, I received 8.2% of the vote, or 10,956 votes. I am told that this is a really amazing accomplishment considering it is my first time running for office. WE did it together. As I said, I have been so inspired by all the people I met on this path and hope to keep inspiring you all to get involved and show our leaders that the time for change has come and that we will not sit back and let them spend our tax dollars murdering innocent people while we have so many pressing needs here at home. We must continue the fight to defund the Military Industrial Complex and put people before profits. For now, I have decided to continue my peace and justice work with the Ojai Cease Fire Now group, who after 4 months of meeting and organizing, got the Ojai City Council to pass a Ceasefire Resolution. We showed that if we persist and educate our leaders about an issue, they will make the right decision. In addition, I plan to continue collaborating with Central Coast Anti-War Coalition’s efforts to educate and mobilize the more than 10,000 voters of the 24th District who voted for Peace, to demand our government stop funding the U.S. War Machine. Right now, I am not sure what my political future holds for another campaign, but I look forward to meeting you at the next march, meeting, or bike ride for peace and justice!We are Stronger Together. Peace,Helena Pasquarella

| | | Another Trump presidency would be a disaster for any number of reasons, but here's another to add to the list: Trump suggested he'll make cuts to Social Security and Medicare. "There is a lot you can do in terms of entitlements, in terms of cutting," he said in an interview on CNBC. Republicans have been trying for years to strip seniors of the benefits they've worked hard to pay into their entire lives. Even though Social Security and Medicare are wildly successful and popular, Republicans are hell-bent on destroying them. President Biden has already responded to Trump's preposterous suggestion and promised to protect these essential programs. But we need to send a crystal-clear message to Trump and Republicans: BACK OFF. | | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=dcd069709f79473cbcedaeb7b9265b2b&_e=i4mNu_nxubhNYQbkToI8pKjn8uWRK5urEV3OMq_MoYk6lPfQ335G4pxHjAviGRjxBtJTbijtmcSfOFGpfQ_QR9Oamv_h04bvdIBFDemhKDgLFXJdp6DC0QNby94YDuDCYvUkikZ2apXFOaxQd3t1IrHfTm9vfH1hXYieXfdMWdh9CMqbFs_p8eiZAy4Nh76bUGUoRP1utaAtQx0jwcYlASc0Lf3ubUBawPD1uLxsYUP1zuWHmx2s5lYGwUMjsqHW4ln8U0QsWjV8VSljc9RgaKYLMFIansJxsdMu1apC3zwBzqtIuOqUbFHDTjvO0ztQiRHgfWnLcKnccZeaEPG5UylKhlvzwjvB51FQEOHqPfx8jhhs1EkVRY0HMmX1czCo0S4xtANZYSJafc9hMZB7uTAS8u8VE4L8sDG20jKqtSM%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Our community immediately sprung into action, organizing a campaign to demand President Biden to apologize and issue a retraction of the word. And just over 24 hours later — he did. This was a victory for our movement and PROOF that our organizing works , and we have the power to make our demands heard — even from the very top. We mobilized quickly, and it paid off. [**Town hall called by ‘We, the people’ in Weld County to discuss county’s sanctuary status with commissioners**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
A town hall meeting to discuss Weld County’s sanctuary status and fiscal responsibility has been called for Wednesday, March 13, a press release from “We, the concerned citizens of Weld County” reads. The email with the press release received by The Rocky Mountain Voice indicates all Weld County commissioners have been invited, along with House District 48 Rep. Gabe Evans. “This gathering aims to discuss and reinforce our collective commitment to ensuring Weld County remains a non-sanctuary county and that taxpayer funds are not used in any capacity related to this matter,” the release reads. The town hall will take place at 5:30 p.m. at the Weld County administrative offices located at 1150 O ST. Greeley, CO 80631. The town hall is aimed at an open dialogue between elected officials and residents to contribute in the decision-making process, the release reads.
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

[**Trump Secret Service driver refutes ‘third-hand’ claim J6 committee relied upon from star witness**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Secret Service agent driving the SUV with then-President Donald Trump inside on January 6, 2021, refuted claims that Trump grabbed for the vehicle's wheel, as per a U.S. House of Representatives report.

* The agent testified that he did not witness Trump reaching for the steering wheel or attempting to enter the front seat during the incident.

* The testimony contradicted claims made by Cassidy Hutchinson, a former White House official, who alleged that Trump grabbed for the wheel after becoming upset about being taken back to the White House instead of the Capitol. Testimony from other White House officials also contradicted Hutchinson's claims.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**COMMENTARY: Among the statistic most meant to mislead, you have the Unemployment Rate**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[CRITICALLY THINKING SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* One of the most monitored of all U.S. statistics — and one frequently used for the most political gain — is the Unemployment Rate. In his most recent work, [John Droz Jr.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) takes a look at how deceptive the Unemployment Rate can be, falling in line with Mark Twain’s theory on the subject of “lies, damned lies and statistics.”

* There are now six different unemployment rates in the US, with the popularly referred to rates being 3.6% (U-3: unemployed) and 6.9% (U-6: out of work). The unemployment rates typically do not account for illegal immigrants, a significant oversight considering the estimated six million new illegal immigrants in the US since 2020. **Adjusting for the estimated four million employable illegal immigrants reveals a significant increase in the unemployment rate, from 3.6% to 5.4% (U-3) and from 6.9% to 8.7% (U-6).**

* The exclusion of illegal immigrants from employment data serves political interests and contributes to a distorted perception of the true unemployment situation in the country.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Timnath Question 1A would restrict annexation, including Ladera land, if passed**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[FORT COLLINS COLORADAN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The fate of the Ladera development project in Timnath hinges on the outcome of the April 2 election, where voters will decide on ballot question 1A. Question 1A, a citizen-led initiative, seeks to restrict the town from annexing land with active mining permits until reclamation is completed, potentially slowing down the project's second phase.

* **Supporters** of Question 1A express concerns about the town's financial responsibility if the mine isn't properly reclaimed, advocating for reclamation before annexation and development.

* **Critics** fear that passing 1A could lead to lawsuits against the town and delay the project, which is expected to provide significant economic benefits, including job opportunities and tax revenue.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

[**Colorado House Democrats push concealed weapons training bill forward**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado House Democrats are pushing forward [House Bill 1174](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which imposes stricter regulations on the concealed carry permitting process. Republicans criticize the bill, arguing that it encroaches upon Second Amendment rights by making it more challenging for law-abiding citizens to exercise their right to bear arms.

* Rep. Scott Bottoms, R-Colorado Springs, questions why individuals seeking to exercise their Second Amendment rights should bear the financial burden of specialized training mandated by the bill, suggesting that the state should fund such programs instead.

* Conservatives are concerned that the legislation targets responsible gun owners rather than addressing criminal behavior, as evidenced by the rejection of a bill aimed at increasing penalties for firearms theft.

* Lawmakers like Douglas County Rep. Brandi Bradley express skepticism about the bill's effectiveness in curbing criminal activity, arguing that it imposes unnecessary regulations on law-abiding citizens without addressing the root causes of gun-related crimes.

[**Polis’ environmental justice plans are in limbo at the Colorado state Capitol. Here’s why.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Governor Jared Polis' efforts to enhance pollution enforcement in disadvantaged communities face uncertainty as the Joint Budget Committee (JBC) rejected the administration's request for eight new employees, citing concerns about the Department of Public Health and Environment's commitment to meeting its goals.

* The rejection was partly based on misinformation from the JBC staff, who mistakenly believed that the department planned to conduct only 115 inspections of facilities producing pollutants in disproportionately impacted communities, when in reality, a higher percentage of inspections have been allocated to such areas in previous years.

* While some Democratic lawmakers are likely to support the request upon clarification, concerns about the state budget's financial constraints may influence decision-making during the final budget deliberations. The Polis administration's request for additional staff aims to implement recommendations from an environmental justice task force and align with Colorado's accord with the EPA, emphasizing strategic inspections and increased public engagement in disproportionately impacted communities.

If you want to receive fewer emails, click If you want to unsubscribe, click = | Peter, my name is Michael B. Moore. I'm a dad to four sons, a community leader, and the descendant of enslaved ancestors here in South Carolina. Now, I'm running for Congress. I want to tell you more about how my family history shaped me into the person I am today, but first, = = My great-great-grandfather, Robert Smalls, was born enslaved and grew up knowing what the total depravity of one's rights felt like. His government viewed him as property of another individual. Robert was conscripted to be a ship pilot for the Confederacy. He learned all he could about his ship and gained the trust of the Confederate captains. Robert had the audacity to use his self-taught skills to steer himself, and his Black crewmates and families to safety in the North. He later came back to South Carolina and served as Congressman for Beaufort. = As a kid, I remember visiting Robert's bust. A lot has changed since then, but my great-great-grandfather's perseverance and grit still runs in my blood. It's helped shape me into the person I am today – and it's why I'm running for Congress to continue his legacy. Robert's story is woven into the fabric of our country. Yet, there are MAGA extremists who are working hard to ensure it never enters school curriculums. They want to erase our history and send us back decades in the fight for voting rights and reproductive freedom. It's unconscionable! My opponent, Nancy Mace, has abandoned her constituents in exchange for Donald Trump's radical agenda. She's been a top supporter of his in Congress, and is even privately campaigning to become his VP pick. In Nancy's eyes, being a public servant is all about her. The Lowcountry deserves a representative who leads with its best interests in mind and is resolved to weed out extremism in Congress. You can count on me to be that leader, but I urgently need you in this fight with me. I'm ready to follow in the footsteps of my great-great-grandfather and fight for South Carolina with perseverance and grit. A lot to howl about: In a remarkable chance encounter hundreds of miles from any other known wolves, two of the canids recently found each other in Sequoia National Forest, where their kind has been absent since the 1920s. Researchers are studying how this breeding pair, now part of the Yowlumni pack, and California’s other 42 known wolves are impacting the ecosystems. The wolves use about 300 square miles in Sequoia National Forest, which showcases nearly half of the giant sequoia groves in the world and many of the largest trees. Wolves are an apex, or “top” predator and eat mostly ungulates like deer and elks. Their presence could prompt other carnivores such as mountain lions and black bears to shift their diets slightly, says Axel Hunnicutt, state gray wolf coordinator at California Department of Fish and Wildlife. It’s the first time wolves are inhabiting an area with large numbers of wild pigs, which can spread invasive plants and hog resources like acorns from other wildlife. “This native carnivore coming back could potentially have a positive effect by utilizing this nonnative species,” says Hunnicutt.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80827148/460509692/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDYwNTMyMGYtOThlMC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X8hKnkcVihqGWGtH8WPhtQ0_KpldFuY3mFque7WC21w=&emci=7ac81a09-98e0-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=d605320f-98e0-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In case you missed it, Alabama Senator Katie Britt had an (off-putting? weird? disturbing?) response to President Biden’s State of the Union address.
The speech inspired thousands of tweets, memes, and even a Saturday Night Live cold open.
But the most disturbing moment from her response was Senator Britt’s graphic story of sex trafficking by cartels at the Mexican border – which she blamed on Biden’s border policies.
_**Here’s the thing: the entire story wasn’t true.**_
**[In a moment, we’ll tell you the truth, but before we do, can you chip in $15 so we can stop right-wing propaganda like this from spreading into our communities and online spaces?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80827149/460509693/-593472309?refcode=20240312-EM-KatieBritt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDYwNTMyMGYtOThlMC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=X8hKnkcVihqGWGtH8WPhtQ0_KpldFuY3mFque7WC21w=)**
**So here are the facts:**
**First,** the victim in Britt’s story wasn’t trafficked during the Biden administration. She was kept in captivity during the Bush administration between 2004-2008.
**Second,** the victim was never trafficked in the U.S., as Britt suggested. The events occurred entirely in Mexico.
**Third,** the victim herself said Mexican cartels didn’t kidnap her, but rather a local family that trapped vulnerable girls and forced them into prostitution.
Peter, the only truth to come out of all this is that Britt and the RNC believe that spreading lies and fear about the southern border will help Donald defeat Joe Biden this November.
**This sort of divisive, xenophobic demagoguery is where fascism thrives. It puts our democracy at risk.**
**This whole, ugly episode is an important reminder about why COURIER exists in the first place. We stop right-wing misinformation like this from spreading by calling it out when we see it. The best part is that we publish in the social media newsfeeds and email inboxes where people actually spend their time. **

clean_body: Katie Britt’s weird response to the State of the Union included a disturbing story – that wasn’t true Peter, In case you missed it, Alabama Senator Katie Britt had an (off-putting? weird? disturbing?) response to President Biden’s State of the Union address. The speech inspired thousands of tweets, memes, and even a Saturday Night Live cold open. But the most disturbing moment from her response was Senator Britt’s graphic story of sex trafficking by cartels at the Mexican border – which she blamed on Biden’s border policies. Here’s the thing: the entire story wasn’t true. = So here are the facts: First, the victim in Britt’s story wasn’t trafficked during the Biden administration. She was kept in captivity during the Bush administration between 2004-2008. Second, the victim was never trafficked in the U.S., as Britt suggested. The events occurred entirely in Mexico. Third, the victim herself said Mexican cartels didn’t kidnap her, but rather a local family that trapped vulnerable girls and forced them into prostitution. Peter, the only truth to come out of all this is that Britt and the RNC believe that spreading lies and fear about the southern border will help Donald defeat Joe Biden this November. This sort of divisive, xenophobic demagoguery is where fascism thrives. It puts our democracy at risk. This whole, ugly episode is an important reminder about why COURIER exists in the first place. We stop right-wing misinformation like this from spreading by calling it out when we see it. By strengthening worker and union protections, we can take actionable steps towards closing the gender pay gap **for good.** As a trade unionist myself, I've seen the role strong unions play in helping women across the country get equal pay, better benefits, workplace safety, and respect on the job.
The proof is in the numbers — according to the Institute for Women’s Policy Research, in all 50 states, women in unionized workforces out-earn their non-union counterparts.
And on top of that, women in unionized positions have stronger employer benefits, including employer-sponsored pension or retirement plans, and a full-range of accessible and affordable healthcare.
**Right now we have the most pro-worker President we’ve had in generations, and we’re only a**** _few_****seats away from a pro-worker House majority that will protect our rights in the workplace. **

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2290%2E552475%2EdVaoBD)
Peter, last week, our opponent David McCormick announced his “strong endorsement” of Donald Trump.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240312-2?refcode=em20240312-2&recurring=1&refcode2=2290_552475_dVaoBD&akid=2290%2E552475%2EdVaoBD)
[**McCormick has made it clear he would be a “yes” vote for an extreme MAGA agenda in the Senate, and we need your help to fight back.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240312-2?refcode=em20240312-2&recurring=1&refcode2=2290_552475_dVaoBD&akid=2290%2E552475%2EdVaoBD)
**[Fight Back ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240312-2?refcode=em20240312-2&recurring=1&refcode2=2290_552475_dVaoBD&akid=2290%2E552475%2EdVaoBD)**
McCormick celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade and would support a nationwide ban on abortion with no exceptions for rape and incest.
He has been endorsed by election deniers and insurrectionists, and even had Trump’s fake electors on his campaign payroll.
We could go on, but this much is clear: If elected, David McCormick would fight for his Wall Street friends in Washington, NOT working families across the Commonwealth.
**Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator who fights for them day in and day out – and that’s Bob Casey. But he’s facing the toughest re-election fight of his career, and we need your help to keep Pennsylvania blue.**
[**So please, Peter, help us stop David McCormick by chipping in $5 or whatever you can right away.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240312-2?refcode=em20240312-2&recurring=1&refcode2=2290_552475_dVaoBD&akid=2290%2E552475%2EdVaoBD)
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._

name: Julia DeGraw
subject: Celebrate our 2024 Legislative Wins!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters
body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80830615/460522212/-25266102?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzMmI0OTkwLTllZTAtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=a1lWT5rN68-KtbbHzD0vfM2LaI3TFCRjFCHmGwvYwLY=&emci=618ed48b-cadf-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=f32b4990-9ee0-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, The Oregon Legislative ended on Thursday, March 7th. With your help, we had some major wins that are worth celebrating! Both Right to Repair (SB 1596) and Marine Reserves (HB 4132) passed with strong bipartisan support! This means that:
* Because of the Right to Repair bill, Oregonians will be able to repair their devices and cut down on e-waste, pollution, and help reduce the digital divide.
* With the Marine Reserves program fully resourced thanks to HB 4132, the program will have the capacity to better engage coastal communities and the Tribes in their work, as well as increase monitoring to help improve its efforts to protect and preserve Oregon’s five Marine Reserves into the future.
* The Healthy Homes grant program received the full $15 million of funding we requested as part of our Climate Budget Priority. The funding was provided as part of the Senate Housing bill, SB 1530, that bill passed both chambers with bipartisan support. This victory means that low-income Oregonians will have better access to resources to weatherize their homes with better insulation, windows, and air filtration, which will improve their indoor air quality during extreme smoke from wildfires, and help lower their energy bills. These improvements will also help their homes stay warmer longer if the power goes out during an ice storm––like happened earlier this year.

These are all great wins for the environment and would not have been possible without your support and advocacy! Thank you for all that you do for our work––[**will you take a moment to let your lawmakers know you appreciate what they accomplished this year, and how you hope for more climate action moving forward?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80830617/460522213/-25266102?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzMmI0OTkwLTllZTAtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=a1lWT5rN68-KtbbHzD0vfM2LaI3TFCRjFCHmGwvYwLY=&emci=618ed48b-cadf-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=f32b4990-9ee0-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=2107230) Our overarching Natural Resources and Environment Budget Priority ended the session with mixed outcomes. Our natural resources state agencies got a lot of really important funding to do crucial work protecting Oregon’s water, air, wildlands, and wildlife. But the policies we’d fought to get funding for this year were largely left untouched. Another priority area where we were unfortunately less successful, was our climate budget priority. We did not get as robust of a climate budget that we were hoping for, with our Charge Ahead EV Rebates program for low-income Oregonians not receiving any funding. That wildly popular program ran out of money and will remain unfunded into 2025. While we are grateful for our wins, we do want to make sure that our leaders take stronger action on climate moving forward. We worked hard with our partners to make sure the governor’s housing bill (SB 1537) was as strong as possible. We were disappointed that the bill still included a large urban growth boundary expansion, but we are grateful for the improvements to the bill and will continue to engage in making sure future housing policy upholds Oregon’s land use and environmental laws. Overall, passing every priority bill this session, stopping almost all bad environmental bills from passing (and there were so many), and getting $15 million for the Healthy Homes Grant Program are all important accomplishments to celebrate and express gratitude for. [**Which is why we hope you will take a moment to let your lawmakers know what they got right this session and that you hope to see more climate action moving forward.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80830618/460522214/-25266102?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzMmI0OTkwLTllZTAtZWUxMS04NWZiLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=a1lWT5rN68-KtbbHzD0vfM2LaI3TFCRjFCHmGwvYwLY=&emci=618ed48b-cadf-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=f32b4990-9ee0-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=2107230) Sincerely,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

I want to introduce you to an amazing patriot and local community leader, Major General (Ret) Marvin Jay Barry of Franklin Township, Carbon County. He's in the middle of this photo, taken last week in Allentown.

A graduate of Lehighton High School, MG Barry became the first Carbon County native to attend the U.S. Air Force Academy. He earned his silver wings as a C-130 pilot in 1971 and promptly deployed overseas, serving two tours in the Vietnam War. He came home, rose up through the ranks, and commanded a combat squadron in Operation Desert Storm. In 2006, MG Barry retired with two Distinguished Service Medals and two Distinguished Flying Crosses, making him one of the highest-ranking and most decorated military veterans in the history of PA’s 7th District.

MG Barry served for several years as a member of Susan Wild’s Congressional Military Academy Nomination Board, which reviews applications from local students to attend the service academies. It’s a role he cherished because he could help launch the military careers of young people seeking to serve their nation, just as he did almost sixty years ago.

Unfortunately, MG Barry is no longer on the Nominations Board. He resigned his position after Susan Wild’s recent comments disparaging the people of Carbon County, which MG Barry said, “crossed a red line.” He wrote in his resignation letter, “I feel that remarks you made in a Jan. 29 news report were extremely offensive to your constituents in Carbon County where I have been a longtime resident.” Indeed. I’m humbled to announce that they're all on the Veterans for Dellicker team. There's more than a century of service in this photo. I'm honored by their service and support.

Here’s a promise to you, MG Barry. If I’m elected your Congressman from PA-7, you can have your spot back on the Academy Selection Board. Then you can continue to serve our community and our nation with honor and dignity, just like you’ve done your entire career.

**Keep America Free.**

clean_body: Remember those articles about elected officials playing hooky? Fleeing town? So does Anthony Broadman. | | | | Peter — Today, I'd like to introduce you to my friend Anthony Broadman. Anthony has served as a Bend City Councilor since 2020 — including as Mayor Pro Tem in 2022 — and now he's campaigning to become a State Senator. One thing about Anthony? He always shows up to the table eager to get the work done. Oregonians have endured years of Republicans in the State Legislature walking out, fleeing town, and hiding from tough conversations — and frankly — the bare minimum of their job: showing up. We don't have time for that foolish behavior, there's too much at stake. And Anthony gets it: "Central Oregon deserves a Senator who will go to work, even when the issues get tough.Our community works too hard and we have too many challenges to entrust our representation to senators who walk out on us and the legislative process.Central Oregon needs a State Senator who reflects our values on human rights, reproductive health care, and protecting our democracy. I will stay at the table and fight for Central Oregon, no matter how hard it gets." — Anthony Broadman Right now, we need folks like Anthony Broadman in the State Senate to prioritize economic opportunity, affordable housing, and keep our communities safe. His track record as a pragmatic and collaborative problem solver on Bend City Council is exactly what we need in Salem to champion real solutions for the climate crisis; support wildfire resiliency; uplift working families; protect and expand reproductive health care; promote gun safety, and strengthen our civil rights. These are going to be the most important topics of conversation in Salem next year, and we need the effective leadership and advocacy of Anthony Broadman at the table. Will you join me in supporting Anthony by chipping in to his campaign? Lynn | ---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Lynn Peterson for Congress |

name: Col. Mike Waltz
subject: Blah blah blah...
body:
| | | **_Blah, blah, blah..._** **Sometimes, it seems like that’s all you hear on Capitol Hill.** _There’s a lot of talk, but no one is willing to do the hard thing and take action._ **That’s not my style.**

My name is Mike Waltz. I’m a Green Beret veteran, a retired Colonel, and an unapologetic conservative.

When I was out on the battlefield, we didn’t get anything done by talking. We acted and responded to threats as they came in.

_Members of Congress could learn a thing or two from America’s bravest._

Today, I’m asking you to stand with me and take action against the radical Left’s assault on our rights.

**[Will you stand with me to DEFEND our American values?](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=bc6a214ba12b4f3c9d179f01f085b6fa&_e=oVbFiR_gcoViL1QCLF_yLekxf6k4J9d1y6wGUgVg0wZtbH1GIQvIcy9ncDsLFZRfNl1mgTgmxycKE4U2Wf6P8bRMR5XC96xrem-wK5bV3e2WV-ypb4Bo9tdwO5Xq5PGi4eEjdJCKrPUQMhZz2oBS4qFtBLOFDkCxWqgF2Klyd3bZsWKy9ymQCcy84Ab1okkOId2WvwooC4GdzaO_TvNSY3egtJhJQI6Dl-TtuTzwErJP3gog0yDJrBhpCodv-y89QeOnHHRkKjUYjU7bxP2wxfSpvieeEl_OEu8XAFWSWmZYdxL92iLAywC9EUbjVMX8xCldXrhsMYat0l-zXSnkKSK2WE9irnyVzCLakf-Vu-g%3D)**

---
[**DEFEND AMERICAN VALUES**](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=bc6a214ba12b4f3c9d179f01f085b6fa&_e=oVbFiR_gcoViL1QCLF_yLekxf6k4J9d1y6wGUgVg0wZtbH1GIQvIcy9ncDsLFZRfNl1mgTgmxycKE4U2Wf6P8bRMR5XC96xrem-wK5bV3e2WV-ypb4Bo9tdwO5Xq5PGi4eEjdJCKrPUQMhZz2oBS4qFtBLOFDkCxWqgF2Klyd3bZsWKy9ymQCcy84Ab1okkOId2WvwooC4GdzaO_TvNSYzHOtNKmBrtt-cCosZfFqP2ioXZz60r0mv2y3id1hMwdYz6HdKiKrb9TkpmqGsXuu_Todwe0xPP7qCkPk_detK-VQNWtZ0ijS_UtPBoiBTOYGtTsD5YSdlcSLntyrgktY3p4T2NAe3YXop56vkiSFa4%3D)
---
Trust me when I say: we’re lucky to live in America.

People in the corners of the world I’ve fought in would do anything to have the rights and freedoms we have here.

But thanks to far-Left Democrats in Congress, those rights and freedoms are under attack.

I didn’t back down when terrorists in Afghanistan were threatening our way of life, and I won’t back down when suited-up socialists do the same.

I know you won’t either.

**[Please, don’t sit on the sidelines. Pitch in NOW and help us fuel our mission to defend our values!](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=bc6a214ba12b4f3c9d179f01f085b6fa&_e=oVbFiR_gcoViL1QCLF_yLekxf6k4J9d1y6wGUgVg0wZtbH1GIQvIcy9ncDsLFZRfNl1mgTgmxycKE4U2Wf6P8bRMR5XC96xrem-wK5bV3e2WV-ypb4Bo9tdwO5Xq5PGi4eEjdJCKrPUQMhZz2oBS4qFtBLOFDkCxWqgF2Klyd3bZsWKy9ymQCcy84Ab1okkOId2WvwooC4GdzaO_TvNSY5WEDVHHFFc0U4oBK38vZAmH9IH4a3BDFMehufwvmPciFeEtdq7gMD9JjVsgEbuucvGTNfIlnLpMM9Ymvdlvjkmyp8htMLGnefRO9h3ubV1B2diWjR95EO5ypS1xVbIUcVqWQ7mjl3aTKYtXc3nDEFw%3D)**

Because when you vote, democracy wins.** Polls are open today from 7 am to 7 pm today. Hi there,

March is Women’s History Month, where we honor and reflect on the achievements of women across the country.

I’m a proud product of the women who have come before me and paved the way – especially my mother, who fled communist Cuba to give our family a better life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80834567/460535740/-401216107?refcode=em-3.12.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmVkNDhmOGMtYTZlMC1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YfUTvzxNFztV8LZmonzniCv07cFNnc_OcG0DoV7fq4w=) _My mom, my daughter Ava, my aunt, and me._
She sewed buttons and zippers in a factory to put dinner on the table and sacrificed so much for us. She taught me the power of hard work, something I’ve carried with me for my entire life.

Make no mistake: **If Schweikert wins AZ-01, Republicans will very likely keep power for two more years and their #1 priority will be to restrict women’s rights nationwide.**

I marched after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned and continue to march today because I knew that I couldn’t stand by and let my daughter have less rights than my mother and I did at her age. It’s unacceptable.

| | **[Today, I’m asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7WgMZyhZWmjhVJY3cVE4QLokKHFoE9CPQVIJcvvCrXuAbD_MPOB77_fZnG2YwnL9aWdu_RRNTGax5mrjB39Jx55tlmm8Be8NAmoJJBUaKlwLqnFaF9yqvQLc14qouLVY-72zpbbQDDVpRcPgG6ipdJ41YlWE9pEDpFA1pQLclaCAyqEihU09liQ02Ilj3vnI7NbZLm4KA8f8Ffm-xrwb17mY2lvO9yToILAX2Ccet8i7z7BEdo-LB8v8wfKp4tcotyQTLzazwL7kQXvAuiorbGAEQf2WZ5PWLY4sqHvpTvJyfBdYPfDMLmyzoO54fpLRzncbroug7p8PVOalO5m304-D6Q5vaC7Hd_PrIPvXy_Mlj4K6_vUi_xdQxNbdP8M0hVTthYbrbMP0Vy9_Z4s_AQAA__-29o2C)** As of March 5th, it’s official. I’m going head-to-head with Adam Schiff in November.Democrat policies have brought America to its knees.There’s fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California.Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. clean_body: The Working Families Party is joining more than 20 other progressive groups and allies to demand that Democratic elected officials and candidates reject AIPAC and their Republican megadonors, once and for all. | | | Peter, This year, Republican megadonors are planning to spend at least $100 million in Democratic primaries to unseat some of our biggest progressive champions in Congress — all through AIPAC, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee. Today, we are fighting back: The Working Families Party is joining more than 20 other progressive groups and allies to demand that Democratic elected officials and candidates reject AIPAC and their Republican megadonors, once and for all. We know we can beat back their attacks and protect our champions — but only if we all do our part. AIPAC has spent years supporting extremist MAGA Republicans, including those who tried to overturn the 2020 election. Now they are aiming their sights directly at Black and brown progressives in Congress who have called for a ceasefire, the safe return of hostages taken by Hamas, and an end to Netanyahu’s siege of Gaza civilians — even as polls show that Democratic voters overwhelmingly support a ceasefire and oppose the U.S. sending more blank checks to the Israeli military. The Republican megadonors fueling these attacks also know that this $100 million effort will also help MAGA achieve their ultimate goal in November: recapturing the White House for Trump and regaining full control of Congress. But our champions in Congress who are under attack have won election after election in their districts because they fight for the constituents they represent — and represent the views of their constituents. If we all come together and make sure we have the resources we need to fight back, we can defeat AIPAC’s Republican-funded primary challengers and preserve the progress we've fought so hard to achieve. #
There’s so much on the line this November — no question about it. The Senate majority is up for grabs. Donald Trump is seeking a return to the White House. And MAGA Republicans are behind him 100% — ready to rubber stamp his extremist, anti-abortion, anti-democracy agenda. With the stakes this big and the dark money millions powering it all, it’s easy to feel powerless. It’s easy to feel like this election is all doom and gloom. And it’s easy to ask yourself: _“Can I really make a difference?”_ **We’re here to tell you today that yes, you absolutely can.** Because here’s how we beat dark money: You, Peter, chip in $5 or $10. Then another person donates, and another, and so on. And that adds up to create something special. Hey Peter — We’re bumping an email from a year ago (yes! really!) back to the top of your inbox because, even though it’s been a while, we have a key update + want to make sure you have the context. As of this month, Walgreens and CVS announced that they’ll begin distributing the abortion pill mifepristone at their pharmacies. This is a meaningful step to increasing access to reproductive health care for women across the country. name: Joe Pereles
subject: Reproductive healthcare is under attack in Missouri
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Reproductive healthcare is once again under attack in Missouri.
This time the target is Planned Parenthood, which operates clinics throughout the state serving communities that have historically lacked reliable access to healthcare, including family planning and reproductive healthcare. On Tuesday, the Missouri House voted to defund Planned Parenthood in our state, less than a week after Missouri Attorney General Andrew Bailey also filed a lawsuit against the organization.
Here’s what it would mean to defund Planned Parenthood: cancer screenings, routine preventive care, and contraception would effectively be cut off for many who would normally not have access to this kind of care . As affordable primary healthcare has gotten scarcer, especially for the under-insured or uninsured, clinics like Planned Parenthood have filled an absolutely crucial need for millions of women, men, and families in need of care.
What we are seeing is an ideological assault on women’s healthcare, disproportionately harming low-income communities (nearly 20% of Planned Parenthood patients in Missouri rely on Medicaid) and individuals with limited options for healthcare providers.
We should be doing more, not less, to help people access healthcare. And most of all, we need to send a message loud and clear that politicians need to get out of our exam rooms and keep their personal agenda out of our private lives.
This issue will now be taken up by the State Senate, where the Democratic caucus will fight hard to block it. If we flip districts like SD-15, the district I am running to represent, we will have more voices fighting back against the rampant extremism that is systematically dismantling the reproductive rights of Missourians.
If you can, I need your support to stand up against these attacks and add another vote for sanity, for common sense, and for coming together to make our state better. clean_body: [] Peter, Reproductive healthcare is once again under attack in Missouri. This time the target is Planned Parenthood, which operates clinics throughout the state serving communities that have historically lacked reliable access to healthcare, including family planning and reproductive healthcare. On Tuesday, the Missouri House voted to defund Planned Parenthood in our state, less than a week after Missouri Attorney General Andrew Bailey also filed a lawsuit against the organization. Here’s what it would mean to defund Planned Parenthood: cancer screenings, routine preventive care, and contraception would effectively be cut off for many who would normally not have access to this kind of care . As affordable primary healthcare has gotten scarcer, especially for the under-insured or uninsured, clinics like Planned Parenthood have filled an absolutely crucial need for millions of women, men, and families in need of care. What we are seeing is an ideological assault on women’s healthcare, disproportionately harming low-income communities (nearly 20% of Planned Parenthood patients in Missouri rely on Medicaid) and individuals with limited options for healthcare providers. We should be doing more, not less, to help people access healthcare. And most of all, we need to send a message loud and clear that politicians need to get out of our exam rooms and keep their personal agenda out of our private lives. This issue will now be taken up by the State Senate, where the Democratic caucus will fight hard to block it. If we flip districts like SD-15, the district I am running to represent, we will have more voices fighting back against the rampant extremism that is systematically dismantling the reproductive rights of Missourians. If you can, I need your support to stand up against these attacks and add another vote for sanity, for common sense, and for coming together to make our state better. | | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/e9e03190-ff0e-4cca-90e5-69609efb52ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Dear Friend,
The moment we've been waiting for has arrived - it's Election Day, and the fate of our nation hangs in the balance. This is our opportunity to shape the future, and we cannot afford to let it slip away. I know some would say it is _**" Only the Primary" **_but in my opinion _**" The Primary" **_is just as important as the****_**General Election.**_ **So lets go vote!!!**
The chance to cast your vote for Donald Trump, a true leader who champions our conservative values and has delivered on his promises, is nothing short of amazing. His unwavering dedication to putting America first is what will revitalize our economy, strengthened our military, and defended our freedoms.
But make no mistake, this election is about more than just one candidate. It's about the soul of our nation, the principles we hold dear, and the direction we want to take. It's about safeguarding our constitutional rights, protecting the unborn, and preserving the American dream for generations to come. **So please get out and vote for those who will stand and fight for freedom!!**
Every vote matters, and yours is needed now more than ever. The stakes could not be higher, and the urgency of this moment cannot be overstated. You only have a few hours left to make your voice heard, so let's not waste a single moment.
Thank you for your unwavering commitment to our cause. **NOW LETS GO VOTE!!**
Sincerely,
Dan Carr

Defending the Senate seats in Wisconsin, Nevada, and Pennsylvania won’t be
easy.

Everyone from Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell to their wealthy dark money
donors knows control of the White House and the Senate will come down to a
few key battleground states.

They’re already spending big to go after Bob Casey, Jacky Rosen, and Tammy
Baldwin — because Pennsylvania, Nevada, and Wisconsin are crucial swing
states.

They know that if we defend the Senate majority, Bobby, Jacky, Tammy, and
I are going to send a whole lot of bills to President Joe Biden’s desk
that the GOP won’t like.

The GOP recruited some candidates they consider “all-stars” (much like my
own opponent, Steve Garvey), but each and every GOP candidate would be a
rubber stamp for an extreme MAGA agenda.

Cuts to Social Security and Medicare, as Trump just proposed on CNBC this
week. Enforcing a nationwide abortion ban. Rolling back climate
protections. Ending the Affordable Care Act and confirming every far-right
judge that Trump can offer.

The difference between building on Democrats’ progress over the last
several years and rolling back all the achievements made by President
Biden and the Senate could come down to Pennsylvania, Nevada, and
Wisconsin. We’ve worked this hard in our race so we can help support
Democrats up and down the ballot, across the country. That’s why we need
to support Bob Casey, Jacky Rosen, and Tammy Baldwin.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80841419/460557164/-1309215324?refcode=WTEFEO27_20240312_CRJohnson_ND_v1s3&sourceid=1053187&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZmNjMTQ4Ny1iYmUwLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6F3Ed4JgLFJM0D8sBSAdOxFonGgqp_gCuByKROktwiY=) Peter,

When Speaker of the U.S. House Mike Johnson was asked whether he believes that the destruction of frozen embryos during the in vitro fertilization (IVF) process is murder, he responded, **"It's something that we've got to grapple with. It's a brave new world."** **[You can watch the interview for yourself here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80841425/460557170/-1309215324?refcode=WTEFEO27_20240312_CRJohnson_ND_v1s3&sourceid=1053187&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZmNjMTQ4Ny1iYmUwLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6F3Ed4JgLFJM0D8sBSAdOxFonGgqp_gCuByKROktwiY=)** The "brave new world" of assisted reproductive technology has been helping Americans start families for more than fifty years. And you would think Mike Johnson, self-proclaimed defender of family values, would support it.

But of course he doesn't. And of course he doesn't understand the science behind the procedure, or the decades of medical research that made IVF possible. Because all Mike Johnson and his Republican cronies want is to control our bodies, take away our rights, strip us of our autonomy, and send us back to the dark ages.

Last month's Alabama Supreme Court ruling — that frozen embryos created through IVF are legally children and can therefore be protected as such — is the latest and most egregious attack on reproductive freedom since the end of _Roe v. Wade_. And with each of these attacks, it becomes more and more clear: **for Republicans, this has only ever been about power over women.** **Peter, we can't let these people stay in power. Every day that Mike Johnson remains speaker of the House is a day that our rights are under attack.
